problem: Customer was charged twice for the same invoice.
resolution: Verify both invoice ids, refund the duplicate charge; it appears on the statement in 3-5 business days.

problem: Invoice shows a wrong or missing VAT ID.
resolution: Update the VAT ID in billing settings and reissue the invoice; the corrected PDF is emailed within one day.

problem: Forgot password, reset email does not arrive.
resolution: Resend the reset link, check the spam folder; the link is valid for 30 minutes.

problem: Two-factor authentication code does not arrive on a new phone.
resolution: Use a backup code to sign in, then re-register the authenticator app or the new phone number in security settings.

problem: App crashes on startup after an update.
resolution: Clear the app cache and reinstall version 4.2.1 or newer; the crash was fixed in 4.2.1.

problem: CSV export produces an empty file.
resolution: Select a date range before exporting; an empty range exports nothing. A bug with the default range is fixed in 4.3.

problem: Package delayed, tracking has not moved for several days.
resolution: After 5 days without a tracking update open a carrier investigation; if not found, reship at no cost.
Send a prepaid return label and ship the correct item once the return is scanned.

problem: Customer wants to cancel the subscription.
resolution: Settings > Plan > Cancel. Access continues until the end of the paid period; there is no partial refund.

problem: Customer asks for a dark mode.
resolution: Logged on the product roadmap as a request; no delivery date can be promised.

problem: API returns HTTP 429 too many requests.
resolution: The limit is 60 requests per minute per key; use exponential backoff and honour the Retry-After header.

problem: Account locked after several failed login attempts.
resolution: The lock lifts automatically after 30 minutes; otherwise verify identity with support.
